About the salon

A small salon with a short menu. Pop in for one treatment between errands, or book three in a row and spend the afternoon with us.

  • Set pricesEach treatment has its price next to it. For colour work we agree the price with you before we start.
  • Several in one goTell us what you would like done and we line the appointments up back to back.
  • Easy to bookCall or send a WhatsApp message. We reply with a time that suits you.

Booking

How to get a time

  1. Pick a treatment

    Everything is on the price list with its duration. Booking several? Add up the times and tell us the total.

  2. Call or message us

    By phone or WhatsApp, Tuesday to Saturday. Name the treatment and a few times that suit you.

  3. Get a confirmation

    We confirm by message. Plans changed? Let us know 24 hours ahead and we move or cancel the appointment at no cost.

Call us → WhatsApp

Studio

MONROE / Stuttgart-Mitte

One room, five crafts and a lot of pink. Here is how we work, where to find us and how to book.

The salon

Made for slow, pretty afternoons.

Come for one treatment or stay for three. We plan the order so you are not sitting with wet polish while your lashes are being done.

How we work

Four things you can count on

  • The price on the list

    What you see on the price list is what you pay. Colour work starts at the listed price; we tell you the final amount before we begin.

  • Clean tools

    Metal tools are cleaned and sterilised after every client. Files and buffers are used once.

  • Patch test first

    First time with lash or brow tint? We test a small spot 48 hours before the appointment.

  • Free changes up to 24 hours

    Move or cancel your appointment at no cost if you tell us at least 24 hours ahead.
